listings.thesis: Watchlist: useful ecosystem node, but evidence of under-discovery or upside-to-valuation is mixed.

priorCase.rankRationale: National Silicon Industry Group should hold because wafers, masks, substrates, photoresists and high-purity materials consumed by AI fabs remains relevant, but current rank 52, 18.3% YTD, $13.9B market cap, valuation discovery or execution risk already captures much of the upside.
